purpose: Define the safe SEIS model scaling path from a 20B local-compatibility target for 16GB+ RAM machines toward future 70B, 150B, 512B AGI research, the user-requested 520B next-frontier boundary, and larger parameter classes without claiming trained weights, AGI capability, or live runtime readiness.
truthBoundary: Repository-local model scaling and hardware compatibility profile only. It creates no trained 20B, 70B, 150B, 512B, 520B, or AGI weights, performs no model download, performs no inference, performs no benchmark, performs no live provider calls, performs no cloud fine-tuning, and does not claim SEIS owns a trained foundation model or a real AGI.

notes: 16GB+ is a target compatibility class, not a verified throughput or memory claim.
The target can become selectable only after clean-room provenance, quantized runtime, memory ceiling tests, redaction tests, and human approval exist.
Core SEIS continues to run with zero cloud provider keys by falling back to Local Demo mode.

frontierTarget.targetHardwareClass: future approved distributed, multi-accelerator, or cloud research class
notes: 150B is a long-horizon SEIS AI research objective, not a local 16GB+ compatibility promise.
No 150B download, training, fine-tuning, inference, benchmark, publication, deployment, SSH, or cloud provisioning is authorized by this profile.
The 150B lane can become scoped only after the 20B and 70B gates produce real evidence and a separate human-approved frontier research plan exists.

apexTarget.targetHardwareClass: human-approved future frontier-scale distributed research class
notes: 512B is an AGI research objective and apex program boundary, not a claim that SEIS currently has AGI.
No 512B download, training, fine-tuning, inference, benchmark, checkpoint publication, deployment, SSH, or cloud/GPU provisioning is authorized by this profile.
All installed AI and sub-agent roles may coordinate review duties only; they cannot create evidence by assertion or approve their own runtime promotion.

nextFrontierTarget.targetHardwareClass: defined only after 512B apex evidence and a human-approved frontier-scale distributed research plan
notes: 520B is a next-frontier boundary for long-horizon SEIS AI planning, not a trained model claim.
No 520B download, training, fine-tuning, inference, benchmark, checkpoint publication, deployment, SSH, or cloud/GPU provisioning is authorized by this profile.
The 520B lane can become scoped only after 512B apex evidence exists and a separate human-approved next-frontier plan is accepted.

planningAssumptions: 20B on 16GB+ requires a quantized local runtime profile.
Usable context length, OS memory pressure, GPU/CPU split, KV cache, tokenizer, runtime overhead, and background apps must be measured on real hardware.
A planning estimate cannot be used as a benchmark or production readiness claim.
